posts.author: brugiordano_x
posts.text:
A year ago I built a voice agent on my laptop. It recorded five seconds of audio, paused for a long time, and answered from a fake CRM.

Today it joins the call, listens to everyone, and answers out loud when you call it by name.

The idea is a voice agent that sits in pipeline reviews, regional syncs and forecast calls, and acts as a best-in-class RevOps.

posts.author: MakTwenty
posts.text:
https://openedBot.app is now 100% open source, and I'm closing the hosted service.

  Over the past months I built OpenedBot: a console to run and supervise AI agents on your own machines. The idea was simple: your agent runs at home or on your server, and it opens a single outbound connection to the console. No inbound port, no data leaving your machine without you knowing.
